title: About A Passage Reopens
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1217 recent saved-signal files and 875 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around Once a poster child for 'ruin porn,' Detroit is making a comeback and Shepherd Arts Center: Detroit’s Historic Cultural Hub, plus 4 more. A source image from cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A Passage Reopens: An abstract civic habitat, cinematic still, street-level wide view angled slightly upward, deep focus. Split a cropped tan window-grid tower left from a low gray pediment mass right across pale sky. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Dark interior contour of the monumental right-hand arch, Small arched opening in the lowest stone wing, and Chipped green decorative inset at the foot of a column.
